# Enable Watermarks

## Goal

Add traceable watermark policies to remote access.

## Suitable Scenarios

- Contractors.
- Customer support access to customer data.
- Remote work.
- BYOD.
- Sensitive internal backends.
- High-risk business pages.

## Watermark Content Recommendations

Use content that can identify the visitor and access time, for example:

```text
Username / employee ID
Access time
Company name
Access environment identifier
```

Do not put new sensitive information into the watermark itself.

## Recommended Combination

```text
User / group permissions
      +
Page sensitive content controls
      +
Watermarks
      +
Recording and replay
```

The value of watermarks is to increase the cost of distributing screenshots and improve traceability after the fact. They should not be described as absolute screenshot prevention.

## Enable Site Watermarks

Go to:

```text
Site Management > Site List
Site Management > Inner Site List
```

Find the target site or inner site and click the "![](/images/site-config.png){width=22px}" button to enter the site or inner site configuration page:

1. Enable **Visible Watermark** and **Invisible Watermark**.
2. Save.
3. Access again with a test account.
4. Verify that the user frontend displays the watermark after accessing the site.

When users open the site from the frontend, they can see the watermarked page, as shown in @fig-watermark.

![Sa2web watermark](/images/site-with-watermark.png){#fig-watermark}

The free edition does not support watermarking.

## Cloud Browser Watermarks

To add watermarks to sites accessed through Cloud Browser, enable the **Cloud Browser Watermark** switch in group management.

Go to:

```text
Group Management > Group List
```

Click **Privileges** to open the group privilege settings page, as shown in @fig-group-privileges-3. Select **Visible Watermark** and **Invisible Watermark**, then save.

![Sa2web group privilege settings](/images/group-privileges-2.png){#fig-group-privileges-3}

When a user opens the Sa2web frontend and accesses the site, the site displays watermark content, as shown in @fig-cloud-browser-watermark.

![Sa2web Cloud Browser watermark](/images/cloud-browser-watermark.png){#fig-cloud-browser-watermark}

## Control Watermark Content

Go to:

```text
Settings > System Settings
```

Open the system settings page and modify the watermark text, as shown in @fig-system-settings-watermark.

![Sa2web system watermark settings](/images/system-settings-watermark.png){#fig-system-settings-watermark}

## Acceptance Checklist

- [ ] A watermark is displayed after the user frontend accesses the site.
- [ ] A watermark is displayed after Cloud Browser accesses the site.
